title: Delete and Earn
statement: Choosing `nums[i]` earns nums[i] points and deletes every occurrence of nums[i] - 1 and nums[i] + 1. You may continue until the array is empty. Return the maximum points.
hints: Equal values do not delete each other. Taking a value earns value times its count.
Taking x forbids x - 1 and x + 1. This is house robber on the number line.
Build an array points[v] = v * count(v), then run the linear robber from 1 to the maximum value.
editorial: Collapse duplicates into points on the integer line. Adjacent integers conflict, non-adjacent integers do not, even if some integers are missing. A missing integer is a house of value 0 and does not change the robber recurrence. The answer is the house-robber result on that points array.

examples.explanation: Take 3, delete 2 and 4, earn 3. Or take 2 and 4 for 6.
